attributes.title: National Nurse Practitioner Symposium 2027
attributes.cme_provider: AKH, Inc., Advancing Knowledge in Healthcare
attributes.summary:
The National Nurse Practitioner Symposium returns to Keystone, Colorado, from July 14 to 17, 2027, with a welcome reception the evening of July 13. The program is written for nurse practitioners and other advanced practice providers, and the organizers present it as family-friendly, so many attendees bring a spouse or children to the mountain resort.

The activity is planned with AKH, Inc. under joint accreditation by ACCME, ACPE and ANCC, and it is also approved through AANP and AAPA. The site says ACNM and NAPNAP accept the credits as well. The 2027 credit totals, fees and hotel details had not been posted when we checked, though a registration portal for 2027 was already linked.
